webhook_url.description: Write-only Discord, Slack, or generic webhook URL. It is encrypted at rest and never returned raw by API, UI, logs, audit metadata, delivery history, or diagnostics.

items.description: Bare mailbox address only; display names and CR/LF are not accepted.

email_recipients.description: Notification recipients. Required for email-channel creation by NotificationChannelCreateRequest. On update, omission preserves the existing masked recipient set; when supplied, the array must be non-empty.

uses_global_smtp.description: For an email channel, true delegates delivery to the service-authenticated Control Panel email relay, which uses globally managed application SMTP settings; false selects deprecated direct-Observability SMTP compatibility. SMTP credentials are never copied into a global-SMTP channel or runtime config. On update, omission preserves the existing mode.

smtp_host.description: Deprecated direct-Observability SMTP compatibility field. Do not supply when uses_global_smtp is true.

smtp_port.description: Deprecated direct-Observability SMTP compatibility field. Do not supply when uses_global_smtp is true.

smtp_tls.description: Deprecated direct-Observability SMTP compatibility field. Do not supply when uses_global_smtp is true.

smtp_from.description: Deprecated direct-Observability SMTP compatibility field. Do not supply when uses_global_smtp is true.

smtp_username.description: Deprecated direct-Observability SMTP compatibility field. Do not supply when uses_global_smtp is true.

smtp_password.description: Deprecated write-only direct-Observability SMTP password. Do not supply when uses_global_smtp is true; it is never returned raw.
